connectors.name: Viktron
connectors.description: Monitors Viktron AgentIRL agents and missions, reviews costs and anomalies, creates and backtests policy rules, checks actions, handles approvals and diagnoses failures.
connectors.use_case: Finding why a billing agent's token spend tripled yesterday, backtesting a rule that blocks refunds over 500 dollars.

connectors.name: Vincen
connectors.description: Hands Vincen cloud agents tasks to build and publish websites, make presentations, write documents and research topics, and follows, answers or cancels the tasks.
connectors.use_case: Asking a Vincen agent for a 10-slide pitch deck on a bakery franchise, then a written report on local competitors.

connectors.name: VLM Run Gateway
connectors.description: Runs open-weight vision, OCR and speech models on documents, images, video and audio, returning markdown or structured JSON, captions, visual answers, summaries, transcriptions and object detection results.

connectors.name: Voice Agent Linter by Modern Mustard Seed

connectors.name: WarmHub
connectors.description: Stores versioned, attributed knowledge for AI agents in repositories of things, assertions and collections, with search, history, graph queries, revisions, retractions and redaction, plus subscriptions, notifications and organization membership.
connectors.use_case: Recording a research agent's findings with confidence and evidence, querying the history of an entity across agents, subscribing to changes in a shared collection.

connectors.name: Watch Any Video

connectors.name: Weave Fabric
connectors.description: Your life's context, in conversation.

connectors.name: welt
